about: App Nap (docs/adr/0066-quality-of-service.mdx, decision 5): the session tells an application how it is presented, all its windows together (AppVisibility), and its host acts on it. Allo (sample/NapProbe.tsx) runs a requestAnimationFrame loop that never ends and shows React Native's AppState and every state it went through; Inbox (PressProbe) is a second application's window. Allo's window active: `active`, its frames running. Inbox's pressed: Allo shown behind it is `inactive`, still running. Allo's pressed again, then Super+M: minimized, `background`, and while it stays hidden its host runs no frame at all (requestAnimationFrame waits, as a hidden tab's) and turns at most once a second (its timers run once a second at most, as a hidden page's). Allo's icon in the dock: restored, `active`, its frames running again.

steps.name: Allo's window takes a press: active, its requestAnimationFrame running
Inbox's window takes a press: Allo, shown behind it, is inactive, its frames still running
five seconds hidden: its host runs no frame, and wakes at most once a second (its timers throttled, nothing trimmed again)
Allo in the dock: restored, active, its frames running again; it went through inactive and background
